title: 鍺光偵測器整合
summary: 以Ge 吸收、載子收集與光電量測基準為主軸，完成 4 階段、24 項模型與判讀作業；包含定量算例、量測基準、失效區分與封裝交接。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 modeling/diagnostic work packages address Ge absorption, carrier collection and optoelectronic reference planes, with quantitative examples, measurement references, failure discrimination and package handoff.
scope: 公開原理與可重算假想算例；不是代工廠配方、設備設定或產品合格界限。代表照片與概念圖不能當作每一步的實物製程影像。
scopeEn: Public principles and reproducible hypothetical examples, not foundry recipes, tool settings or product acceptance limits. Representative photos and concept diagrams are not images of each actual process operation.

steps.title: 定義吸收區與光路：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Define absorber and optical path: model and design
steps.objective: 建立定義吸收區與光路的可驗證模型及適用邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a verifiable model and validity boundary for define absorber and optical path.
steps.instruction: 先標出「定義吸收區與光路」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。矽波導把光模態引入 Ge 吸收區，重疊與長度共同決定吸收。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for define absorber and optical path. A silicon guide delivers a mode to the Ge absorber; overlap and length jointly set absorption. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 畫模態在 Ge 與 Si 的分布，分開耦入與吸收損失。
steps.observationEn: Map the mode in Ge/Si and separate coupling from absorption loss.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「只要有 Ge 就能吸收所有入射光」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Any Ge region absorbs all incident light" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交定義吸收區與光路的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：畫模態在 Ge 與 Si 的分布，分開耦入與吸收損失。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for define absorber and optical path: Map the mode in Ge/Si and separate coupling from absorption loss. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.title: 量測如何區分解釋
knowledge.text: 畫模態在 Ge 與 Si 的分布，分開耦入與吸收損失。 不可推成：只要有 Ge 就能吸收所有入射光
knowledge.textEn: Map the mode in Ge/Si and separate coupling from absorption loss. Do not infer: Any Ge region absorbs all incident light

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設 1550 nm 光、外部量子效率 η=0.80（以指定晶片端口功率為基準），R=ηqλ/(hc)≈ηλ(μm)/1.23984=1.000 A/W。100 μW 入射產生約 100 μA 光電流；若暗電流 1 μA，總讀值約 101 μA，計算 R 前需扣除暗值。 外部量子效率已包含所定參考面到收集電流的損失；內部效率、吸收比例與封裝入射功率不可混用。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical 1550 nm light and external quantum efficiency 0.80 referenced to a defined chip port, R=ηqλ/(hc)≈1.000 A/W. A 100 μW input gives about 100 μA photocurrent; with 1 μA dark current the total is about 101 μA, requiring dark subtraction. External efficiency includes losses between the defined reference plane and collected current; internal efficiency, absorption fraction and package-input power must not be conflated.

矽波導把光模態引入 Ge 吸收區，重疊與長度共同決定吸收。

A silicon guide delivers a mode to the Ge absorber; overlap and length jointly set absorption.

steps.title: 檢查材料缺陷：模型與設計

knowledge.text: 重算 1.000 A/W 並檢查是否使用 μm 而非 nm 代入簡式。 不可推成：相同量子效率在所有波長都有相同 A/W
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate 1.000 A/W and check μm versus nm in the reduced formula. Do not infer: Equal quantum efficiency gives equal A/W at all wavelengths

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設 1550 nm 光、外部量子效率 η=0.80（以指定晶片端口功率為基準），R=ηqλ/(hc)≈ηλ(μm)/1.23984=1.000 A/W。100 μW 入射產生約 100 μA 光電流；若暗電流 1 μA，總讀值約 101 μA，計算 R 前需扣除暗值。 外部量子效率已包含所定參考面到收集電流的損失；內部效率、吸收比例與封裝入射功率不可混用。
knowledge.textEn: For hypothetical 1550 nm light and external quantum efficiency 0.80 referenced to a defined chip port, R=ηqλ/(hc)≈1.000 A/W. A 100 μW input gives about 100 μA photocurrent; with 1 μA dark current the total is about 101 μA, requiring dark subtraction. External efficiency includes losses between the defined reference plane and collected current; internal efficiency, absorption fraction and package-input power must not be conflated.

quiz.question: 就「驗算量子效率」而言，哪項原理正確？
quiz.questionEn: For calculate quantum efficiency, which principle is correct?
options: 反向偏壓越高永遠越好
每個被收集光子產生的電荷把功率轉為電流，響應度的 A/W 依波長改變。
相同量子效率在所有波長都有相同 A/W
optionsEn: Higher reverse bias is always better
Collected charge per photon converts optical power to current, so A/W responsivity depends on wavelength.
Equal quantum efficiency gives equal A/W at all wavelengths
quiz.explanation: 每個被收集光子產生的電荷把功率轉為電流，響應度的 A/W 依波長改變。 外部量子效率已包含所定參考面到收集電流的損失；內部效率、吸收比例與封裝入射功率不可混用。
quiz.explanationEn: Collected charge per photon converts optical power to current, so A/W responsivity depends on wavelength. External efficiency includes losses between the defined reference plane and collected current; internal efficiency, absorption fraction and package-input power must not be conflated.

steps.title: 驗算量子效率：量測與判別
steps.titleEn: Calculate quantum efficiency: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 用驗算量子效率的量測證據區分競爭解釋。
steps.objectiveEn: Use measurements of calculate quantum efficiency to distinguish competing explanations.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，執行下列資料判讀：重算 1.000 A/W 並檢查是否使用 μm 而非 nm 代入簡式。 將原始量、單位、量測參考面與重複性分欄記錄；比較預測與觀察，說明能排除「相同量子效率在所有波長都有相同 A/W」的直接證據，再決定接受、重測或修模。 假設 1550 nm 光、外部量子效率 η=0.80（以指定晶片端口功率為基準），R=ηqλ/(hc)≈ηλ(μm)/1.23984=1.000 A/W。100 μW 入射產生約 100 μA 光電流；若暗電流 1 μA，總讀值約 101 μA，計算 R 前需扣除暗值。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and perform this data review: Recalculate 1.000 A/W and check μm versus nm in the reduced formula. Record raw values, units, reference planes and repeatability separately. Compare prediction with observation and identify direct evidence rejecting "Equal quantum efficiency gives equal A/W at all wavelengths" before accepting, remeasuring or revising. For hypothetical 1550 nm light and external quantum efficiency 0.80 referenced to a defined chip port, R=ηqλ/(hc)≈1.000 A/W. A 100 μW input gives about 100 μA photocurrent; with 1 μA dark current the total is about 101 μA, requiring dark subtraction.
steps.observation: 重算 1.000 A/W 並檢查是否使用 μm 而非 nm 代入簡式。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate 1.000 A/W and check μm versus nm in the reduced formula.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「相同量子效率在所有波長都有相同 A/W」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Equal quantum efficiency gives equal A/W at all wavelengths" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交驗算量子效率的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：重算 1.000 A/W 並檢查是否使用 μm 而非 nm 代入簡式。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for calculate quantum efficiency: Recalculate 1.000 A/W and check μm versus nm in the reduced formula. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.
